findings: Scope: this is the first-pass review of the scene scripts only. The finished film, the new contact sheet and the sampled stills do not exist yet, so none of the four advisories is ruled closed here. The rulings, each citing its proof still, are made in the second pass. The stills in the tree are from the previous film and were not used as evidence.

Design system: design/DESIGN.md and design/tokens.json exist but every token is TODO. Nothing in the scene scripts uses an undefined token, so there are no token findings. The scripts are judged against the four polish advisories in the spec.

Advisory 1 (section 4 title): scene_line.py s4 moves the "Stations build" title to z 5.28, with the band at about z 4.9 to 5.7. The comment puts the highest arm tip and cap at about z 4.37, so the band should clear the full moving envelope. The title is keyed to move with the camera in x, so it stays on screen. For the second pass, check frame-mid-4.png and the section 4 transition stills for any line geometry crossing the glyphs.

Advisory 2 (section 6 captions): both captions are now parented to the camera at -4 units. "A human approves." sits at upper right and "Verified memory." at upper left, in different screen columns and at different heights. The second caption's timing is staggered, with "Verified memory." appearing at 0.40 to 0.47 of the section. Wording is unchanged. Check frame-mid-6.png and frame-cut-6-last.png for legibility and no overlap with the archive or gate geometry.

Advisory 3 (section 1 title): the title now uses the INK material from frame 1, with no pale-gray keying. Its scale is 0.97 of full at frame 1 and full at 0.15 of the section, then 1.03 at the end. The dolly and the line assembly keyframes are untouched. Check frame-mid-1.png and the new frame-proof-s1-title.png for ink color, scale and contrast.

Advisory 4 (section 2 dead air): the card's X tilt now runs 78 to 0 degrees over the flight, where it was near edge-on before. The camera keys now ride about 5.5 units off the card with the target just ahead of it. The timing keys are unchanged, so no frames are cut. The residual risk is that the card may still read small at the midpoint. That can only be judged on frame-mid-2.png, along with a check of the other sampled midpoints and transitions for empty paper.

Sampling: assemble.py keeps frame-mid-{s} for every section. It adds cut-last and cut-first pairs for the cuts after sections 1 to 6, so every cut is sampled. It adds frame-proof-s1-title.png at about 30 percent of section 1, which is frame round(0.30*n). The tiling uses a variable count and 4 columns, so the extra tiles are handled.
Render budget: common.py setup_render keeps samples=6 as the default, with raytracing and shadows off. No render, encode or sheet extraction was run in this review.
